admission: Every planned module must have a canonical JUnit case list, at least one pass, zero failures/errors, and exact agreement on IDs and statuses against a separately collected stock regrtest run. Skip cases are recorded, not treated as passes.
scope: Local direct execution and a reusable external job. Absolute timings include scheduling, processes and per-task durable writes after setup. Report setup, end-to-end excluding source acquisition, and no external performance claims until live observation.
selection_rule: Retain modules that reported no failure and completed before the 90-second reference limit on this host. A later whole-cohort run must publish a complete JUnit reference and independent batches.
